verdict.rationale: BVNK documents per-customer virtual accounts in USD, EUR and GBP, and wallets created against a customer ID and reference. On the crypto side it offers two ways to give each payer a unique address: channels, which are fixed, reusable blockchain addresses, and a unique blockchain address generated for every payment. A channel-transaction-confirmed webhook and ledger reconciliation reports support matching incoming funds automatically. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that virtual accounts are named in the customer's own name, documentation that pay-in webhook payloads carry the customer or reference identifiers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
